## Intent

What user need or reproducible failure does this change address?

## What changed

Describe the smallest correction and any privacy or provider boundary changes.

## Verified

List exact checks, affected journeys, isolated data and evidence. Distinguish
fixtures from live proof. Do not attach raw traces, personal paths or credentials.

- [ ] I ran the local gate and affected UI journeys.
- [ ] Changed unit/UI tests passed ten consecutive times without retries.
- [ ] I updated affected documentation and reviewed the publication manifest.
- [ ] I checked dependency terms and advisories for dependency changes.
- [ ] I used no personal state, provider secrets or unapproved device/account access.

## Risk

Name the behavior affected, rollback and remaining evidence gaps.

## Not done

State unproved or deliberately deferred work. Passing checks are not permission to publish.
